title: مصباح العاصفة

shots.composition: Omar foreground-right and Nader background-left near the storm window; centered workbench and emergency lamp clearly visible.
shots.action: يومض الضوء ثم ينطفئ، فيلتفت عمر إلى مصباح الطوارئ.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D workshop at night, Omar in teal jacket and glasses foreground-right, Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron background-left, emergency lamp on centered workbench, storm window camera-left, light flickers then dims, readable faces, no background people.
animation_notes: Use one clear light flicker and a small head turn; keep Omar's mouth visible for the line.
continuity_requirements: Omar wears teal jacket and glasses; Nader wears orange hoodie and navy apron; storm window camera-left; workbench centered.

shots.composition: Nader framed from chest up with the storm window behind him; Omar remains a soft silhouette at frame edge.
shots.action: ينظر نادر إلى المطر ثم يعود ببصره إلى المصباح.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D medium close-up of Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron, front three-quarter face, storm window camera-left with rain, Omar only as soft edge silhouette, cool blue low light, lip-sync friendly.
animation_notes: Minimal eye and head movement; keep Nader's lips unobstructed.
continuity_requirements: Nader's approved outfit visible; Omar only at frame edge; preserve cool storm-blue lighting.

shots.composition: Omar beside the lamp, with the battery indicator visible but no detailed repair steps.
shots.action: يفحص عمر مؤشر المصباح ويرفع حاجبيه عندما يجده سليمًا.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D medium close-up of Omar in teal jacket and glasses beside an old emergency lamp, front three-quarter face, simple battery indicator glow, centered workbench, storm window camera-left, no other character visible, lip-sync friendly.
animation_notes: Small glance from indicator to camera direction; no detailed hand mechanics.
continuity_requirements: Only Omar visible; teal jacket and glasses unchanged; lamp remains centered.

shots.composition: Nader points toward a visibly loose wire without showing a technical repair procedure.
shots.action: يشير نادر إلى السلك المفصول وينظر إلى عمر خارج الكادر.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D medium close-up of Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron pointing toward one loose wire beside the emergency lamp, front three-quarter face, Omar off-screen, storm window camera-left, simple safe visual, lip-sync friendly.
animation_notes: One simple pointing gesture; keep face and mouth clear.
continuity_requirements: Only Nader visible; loose wire position established and unchanged in later shots.

shots.composition: Omar leans toward the lamp while Nader watches from behind, both faces readable.
shots.action: يمد عمر يده بسرعة نحو السلك بينما يراقبه نادر.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D medium shot, Omar in teal jacket and glasses front three-quarter leaning toward the emergency lamp, Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron watching behind him, centered workbench, storm window camera-left, readable faces, lip-sync friendly.
animation_notes: Use a short controlled reach; avoid complex finger animation.
continuity_requirements: Both approved outfits visible; wire remains in the established position; no detailed repair action.

shots.composition: A tiny harmless spark appears near the lamp; both characters recoil slightly, with no dialogue.
shots.action: تظهر شرارة صغيرة غير مؤذية، فيتراجع الصديقان خطوة.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D close reaction shot of Omar and Nader beside the emergency lamp, tiny harmless spark near the loose wire, both recoil slightly, no fire, no damage, no dialogue, storm window camera-left, safe family animation.
animation_notes: One brief spark flash and a small synchronized recoil; mouths closed.
continuity_requirements: Spark is tiny and harmless; lamp and wire positions remain consistent; approved outfits unchanged.

shots.composition: Nader raises one open palm to slow Omar down; Omar is visible at the edge listening.
shots.action: يرفع نادر كفه طالبًا التمهل، فيتوقف عمر.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D medium close-up of Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron, front three-quarter face, open palm calming gesture, Omar in teal jacket and glasses visible at frame edge listening, storm window camera-left, lip-sync friendly.
animation_notes: Keep the palm gesture simple and Nader's mouth fully visible.
continuity_requirements: Nader is the only speaker; Omar remains silent at frame edge.

shots.composition: Omar steadies the lamp on the workbench; Nader waits opposite him.
shots.action: يثبت عمر المصباح بهدوء وينظر إلى نادر.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D medium close-up of Omar in teal jacket and glasses, front three-quarter face, calmly steadying the emergency lamp on the centered workbench, Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron opposite him, storm window camera-left, lip-sync friendly.
animation_notes: Use a simple two-hand hold without detailed fingers; keep Omar's lips visible.
continuity_requirements: Both outfits unchanged; lamp stable on centered workbench; cool storm-blue light remains.

shots.composition: Nader completes one simple non-technical motion near the loose wire and looks toward the lamp.
shots.action: ينهي نادر الحركة البسيطة ثم يشجع عمر على التجربة.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D medium close-up of Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron, front three-quarter face, one simple non-technical motion near the established loose wire, Omar silent in background, centered workbench, storm window camera-left, lip-sync friendly.
animation_notes: Keep the motion abstract and simple; no instructional electrical detail; mouth visible.
continuity_requirements: Nader is the only speaker; wire returns to its established position; approved outfits unchanged.

shots.composition: The emergency lamp turns on and fills the workshop with warm amber light as both characters smile.
shots.action: يضيء المصباح، فيبتسم عمر ونادر بينما يستمر المطر خلف النافذة.
shots.visual_prompt: Stylized cinematic 3D wide hero shot of the workshop, emergency lamp glowing warm amber on centered workbench, Omar in teal jacket and glasses and Nader in orange hoodie and navy apron smiling together, storm window camera-left with rain, warm light on both faces, clean silhouettes, no background people.
animation_notes: Use a gentle light bloom, small smiles, and minimal breathing motion; no dialogue.
continuity_requirements: Final warm amber lighting replaces cool darkness; both approved outfits visible; window and workbench positions unchanged.

global_visual_notes: Stylized cinematic 3D animation with clean silhouettes and readable facial expressions.
Keep the storm window camera-left and the main workbench centered in every shot.
Use cool storm-blue lighting before the final shot and warm amber lighting in the final shot.
Speaking shots must use front or three-quarter faces with unobstructed mouths.
continuity_notes: Omar wears a teal jacket and glasses whenever he appears.
Nader wears an orange hoodie and navy apron whenever he appears.
The emergency lamp remains on the centered workbench throughout the episode.
The loose wire keeps the same screen position until the final reconnection.
Only characters listed in each shot may appear clearly in that shot.
production_risks: Avoid detailed hand animation and any instructional electrical procedure.
Keep the tiny spark brief, harmless, and visually simple.
Do not use overhead angles for dialogue shots.
Maintain exact character clothing and prop placement across all generated images.
